result.answer:
Hydrogen rose overall; ethylene fell overall.

Window: **Jan 15 inclusive–Jan 19 exclusive**, with four valid samples per gas. First samples were Jan 15; last were Jan 18.

| Gas | First (ppm) | Last (ppm) | Min (ppm) | Max (ppm) | Mean (ppm) | Daily change (ppm/day) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| Ethylene | 16,684 | 16,600 | 16,500 | 16,700 | 16,621 | −28.00 |

Daily change = (last − first) ÷ 3 elapsed days. Neither gas increased consistently each day.
